winning_hook_formulas: The 'Stop/Warning' Formula: [Negative Action] + [Specific Financial Asset] + [Critical Consequence] (e.g., 'Stop buying X before you check Y')
The 'Hidden Loss' Formula: [Common Financial Product] + [Quantified Negative Impact] + [Timeframe] (e.g., 'Your X is secretly losing you Y every day')
script_directives: Maintain a strict duration of 20-22 seconds; remove all fluff and introductory greetings.
Use a high-contrast visual or text overlay within the first 2 seconds to validate the hook's urgency.
Focus on a single, actionable 'contrarian' insight rather than explaining broad, complex systems.
seo_directives: Use high-intent keywords in the title that challenge common retail investor behavior (e.g., 'Stop', 'Trap', 'Secretly').
Limit hashtags to 3-4 high-volume, niche-specific tags (e.g., #StockMarketIndia, #PersonalFinance, #InvestingTips) to avoid algorithm confusion.
